teaser.en: A wild yam that hangs purple 'potatoes' from its twining stems as well as growing one underground.
teaser.sw: Kiazi-pori kinachoning'iniza 'viazi' vya zambarau kwenye mashina yake yanayojizungusha, na pia kukuza kimoja chini ya ardhi.

summary.en: Mani is a wild yam, a twining climber with heart-shaped leaves and a round tuber. It also bears purple aerial tubers on the stem.
summary.sw: Mani ni kiazi-pori, mtambaa unaojizungusha wenye majani ya umbo la moyo na kiazi cha mviringo. Pia huzaa viazi vya zambarau vinavyoota juu ya shina.

about.en: Mani is a twining climber with smooth stems up to about three metres long. It grows from a round tuber that is renewed each year. Its leaves are alternate and heart-shaped, narrowing to a long point. Like several yams, it also forms small tubers, called bulbils, in the leaf axils on the stem. In this species they are irregularly round, up to 5 cm across, and deep purple. The stems die back in the dry season.
about.sw: Mani ni mtambaa unaojizungusha wenye mashina laini yenye urefu wa hadi takriban mita tatu. Huota kutoka kiazi cha mviringo kinachojifanya upya kila mwaka. Majani yake huota kwa kupishana, yana umbo la moyo na huishia kwenye ncha ndefu. Kama viazi vikuu kadhaa, pia hufanya viazi vidogo, viitwavyo bulbili, kwenye makwapa ya majani juu ya shina. Kwa spishi hii, viazi hivyo vina mviringo usio sawa, upana wa hadi sentimita 5, na rangi ya zambarau iliyokolea. Mashina hunyauka wakati wa kiangazi.

where.en: It is a plant of seasonally dry bush and woodland, found from Kenya south to Namibia, climbing over shrubs.
where.sw: Ni mmea wa vichaka na misitu ya miti iliyotawanyika ambayo hukauka kwa msimu, unaopatikana kuanzia Kenya kusini hadi Namibia, ukipanda juu ya vichaka.

names.en: Digo: *mani*. Pakia records it only for Digo and gives no meaning. He writes the species name '*astericus*'; the correct form is *Dioscorea asteriscus*. Several other yams have Digo names. *Mriga* (*D. dumetorum*) is the edible bitter yam and *mriga yere* its 'false' look-alike, while *vwivwi koma* is a wild yam that may be poisonous. Many wild yams are bitter or toxic unless specially prepared, and Pakia records no food use for *mani*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mani*. Pakia anaurekodi kwa Kidigo tu na hatoi maana yake. Anaandika jina la spishi '*astericus*'; umbo sahihi ni *Dioscorea asteriscus*. Viazi-pori vingine kadhaa vina majina ya Kidigo. *Mriga* (*D. dumetorum*) ni kiazi-pori kichungu kinacholiwa na *mriga yere* ni mfanano wake 'bandia', huku *vwivwi koma* ni kiazi-pori kinachoweza kuwa na sumu. Viazi-pori vingi ni vichungu au vina sumu visipotayarishwa kwa njia maalumu, na Pakia haripoti matumizi ya *mani* kama chakula.

reason.en: Another tuberous plant of the coastal bush
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wenye kiazi wa vichaka vya pwani
